why: S1: evaluate the WATCH triggers and write the inbox.
S5: the weekly State of PAN.
Fix documentation that drifted from the code. Docs only; evaluator files are out of scope whatever the lane says.
prompt: Run node scripts/test-surface.cjs --liveness and the doc tests (node --test tests/doc*.test.cjs). Fix any documentation under docs/ or README.md that disagrees with the code. Change no other file. Commit with a message starting docs(bot):.

why: (a) Kill a surviving mutant: the gate is a re-probe at the same seed, as mechanical as it gets.
prompt: Run node scripts/mutation-probe.cjs --seed 7 --json and pick one surviving mutant. Add or strengthen a test under tests/ so it fails on that mutant and passes on the real code. Work only on the target named. Commit with a message starting fix(bot):. Change no evaluator file (scenarios, allowlists, lints, coverage policy, CI).

why: (b) Cover an unreferenced surface row: test-surface --check names it, a test referencing it closes it.
prompt: Run node scripts/test-surface.cjs --scaffold <scratch dir> and pick one unreferenced row. Write a real test for it under tests/. Work only on the target named. Commit with a message starting fix(bot):. Change no evaluator file (scenarios, allowlists, lints, coverage policy, CI).

why: (c) Cover a dispatcher arm the coverage gate says never ran.
prompt: Run npm run test:coverage and pick one dispatcher case arm that never executed. Write a test that runs it and checks its output. Work only on the target named. Commit with a message starting fix(bot):. Change no evaluator file (scenarios, allowlists, lints, coverage policy, CI).

why: (d) Doc-lint and link fixes: checked by the doc tests.
prompt: Run the doc tests (node --test tests/doc*.test.cjs) and fix one failing claim or link under docs/ or README.md. Work only on the target named. Commit with a message starting fix(bot):. Change no evaluator file (scenarios, allowlists, lints, coverage policy, CI).

why: (e) Turn an open harness finding green: needs the harness, a heavier gate.
prompt: Read harness/ledger.jsonl, pick one open finding (no resolved_at), and fix the cause in PAN's source, with a test. Work only on the target named. Commit with a message starting fix(bot):. Change no evaluator file (scenarios, allowlists, lints, coverage policy, CI).

why: (f) Prompt changes: the least mechanical gate, last to unlock.
prompt: Run node scripts/prompt-lint.cjs and fix one finding in a shipped prompt. Work only on the target named. Commit with a message starting fix(bot):. Change no evaluator file (scenarios, allowlists, lints, coverage policy, CI).

why: S6: PAN on PAN. One open harness finding through /pan:quick --full on a worktree of this repository, PAN installed from the packed tarball into a scratch --global --config-dir; harness/autopilot/dogfood.cjs.
